```{r setup, include=FALSE}

  echo = TRUE,

# ── Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

})


# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Creates `path`, and its parents, when it does not exist.
createDir <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}


# ── Palettes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Tableau 10 under colourblind-safe names; the category palette below is built from it.
tableau_10 <- paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10")
names(tableau_10) <- c(
  "blue", "orange", "vermillion", "bluish_green",
  "green", "yellow", "reddish_purple", "pink",
  "brown", "gray"
)

category_palette <- c(
  "Normal" = tableau_10[["gray"]],
  "Dubious" = tableau_10[["blue"]],
  "Extreme" = tableau_10[["vermillion"]],
  "Both" = tableau_10[["reddish_purple"]]
)

removal_palette <- c(
  Discarded = tableau_10[["vermillion"]],
  Good = tableau_10[["green"]]
)
```

## 1. Data Import and Validation

This section loads the filtered CAAS data and validates input files.

```{r data_import, message=FALSE}
# ── Filtered discovery ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

filtered_discovery_path <- params$discovery_input
if (is.null(filtered_discovery_path)) {
  stop("Filtered discovery file parameter is NULL")
}

cat(sprintf("Attempting to load: %s\n", filtered_discovery_path))
cat(sprintf("  File exists: %s\n", file.exists(filtered_discovery_path)))
cat(sprintf("  Working directory: %s\n", getwd()))

if (!file.exists(filtered_discovery_path)) {
  # Show the working directory to help locate a misplaced input.
  cat("Files in current directory:\n")
  print(list.files(".", full.names = TRUE))
  stop("Filtered discovery file not found: ", filtered_discovery_path)
}

discovery_df <- read_tsv(filtered_discovery_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# The columns of discovery.tab are lowercase (gene, trait, position, pattern, ffgn, ...).
# Only the structural keys are renamed to the CamelCase names this report joins on (Gene,
# Position; GenePos = paste(Gene, Position)). The other columns, including the `pattern`
# contrast index, keep their lowercase names.
.disc_keymap <- c(Gene = "gene", Position = "position")
for (.new in names(.disc_keymap)) {
  .old <- .disc_keymap[[.new]]
  if (.old %in% names(discovery_df) && !(.new %in% names(discovery_df))) {
    names(discovery_df)[names(discovery_df) == .old] <- .new
  }
}

cat(sprintf("Loaded discovery file: %s\n", basename(filtered_discovery_path)))
cat(sprintf("  Total CAAS positions: %s\n", format(nrow(discovery_df), big.mark = ",")))


# ── Filtered background ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

filtered_background_path <- params$background_input
if (is.null(filtered_background_path) || !file.exists(filtered_background_path)) {
  stop("Filtered background file not found: ", filtered_background_path)
}

background_df <- read_tsv(filtered_background_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Loaded background file: %s\n", basename(filtered_background_path)))
cat(sprintf("Total genes in background: %s\n", format(nrow(background_df), big.mark = ",")))


# ── Required columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

required_cols <- c("Gene", "Position", "pattern")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(discovery_df))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in discovery: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

```

## 2. Pattern-Based Analysis

Analyze CAAS patterns across discovered positions.

```{r pattern_analysis}
# Columns the meta_caas export reads; filled with NA when the table does not carry them.
if (!"is_conserved_meta" %in% names(discovery_df)) {
  discovery_df <- discovery_df %>% mutate(is_conserved_meta = NA)
}
if (!"conserved_pair" %in% names(discovery_df)) {
  discovery_df <- discovery_df %>% mutate(conserved_pair = NA_character_)
}

caas_for_export <- discovery_df

# ── Pattern distribution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pattern_summary <- caas_for_export %>%
  group_by(pattern) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nPattern Distribution:\n")
print(kable(pattern_summary, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")))

p_pattern <- ggplot(pattern_summary, aes(x = factor(pattern), y = Total, fill = factor(pattern))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "CAAS Pattern Distribution",
    x = "Pattern",
    y = "Candidate Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 20, r = 20)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "darkgray", size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_pattern)
```
